cloud_globe_not_published: Not published yet (publish to open it)
cloud_globe_stale: Open the public page (changes not published yet)
cloud_publish_needs_token: Publishing needs a Cloudflare API token.
cloud_publish_setup_link: Set it up under Site → Cloudflare publication settings (the steps are explained there)
cloud_publish_needs_public_worker: Publishing is not possible: no public Worker is set. Set a public Worker separate from the management Worker.
integrity_cloud_program_na: Program files: not applicable to the Cloud edition (the program is the deployed Worker).
integrity_cloud_not_published: The public site's files cannot be checked yet because nothing has been published.
integrity_cloud_unreachable: Files that could not be read from the public site (%s). Check the public site address and the network.
integrity_cloud_unverified: Files without a record from publication, which could not be checked (%s).
integrity_cloud_truncated: There are many files; only the first 3000 were checked.
